title: State of Karnataka v. M. Jaishankar @ Psycho Shankar
crime_type: Serial Highway Abduction / Sexual Assault / Homicide / Prison Escape
court_or_authority: High Court of Karnataka / Fast Track Sessions Court Tumkur
source: High Court of Karnataka Official Judgment & Indian Kanoon (doc/4182910)
ipc_sections: Section 224 IPC (Resistance or obstruction by a person to his lawful apprehension)
Section 366 IPC (Kidnapping woman to compel marriage or illicit intercourse)
location: Karnataka, Tamil Nadu & Andhra Pradesh interstate border highways, India
evidence: Recovery of an interstate commercial heavy vehicle (truck) with victim bloodstains on cabin sleeper berths
DNA matches linking semen recovered from multiple highway victims across Tamil Nadu and Karnataka to suspect's genetic profile
Seizure of victim personal ornaments, mobile handsets, and identity cards concealed at his rural farmhouse
CCTV and perimeter sensor logs of escape from Bangalore Central Prison (Parappana Agrahara) scaling a 30-foot wall
Testimony of surviving victims identifying accused in test identification parades
modus_operandi: Operated as a long-distance interstate truck driver along NH-4, NH-7, and state highways. Targeted lone women walking near rural toll plazas, farm boundaries, and remote highway bus stops. Forced victims into the truck cabin, drove to isolated eucalyptus plantations, committed sexual violence, bludgeoned or strangled victims, looted jewelry, and fled into adjoining state jurisdictions.
personality_disorder: Clinical evaluation by NIMHANS (National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences) Bangalore: Severe Antisocial Personality Disorder, hyper-sexual aggression, sadistic paraphilia, high physical agility, and complete remorselessness.
common_traits: Use of interstate heavy transport trucks as mobile crime scenes
Exploiting jurisdictional borders between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu to elude police
Extreme physical violence following sexual assault
High capability for physical evasion and escape from maximum security custody
Theft of victim mobile phones and small jewelry
summary: Serial predator linked to more than 30 sexual assaults and 15 murders across Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh between 2008 and 2011. Convicted across multiple jurisdictions and notoriously escaped twice from prison before re-capture by the Bangalore City Crime Branch.
